name: Dixie | 200mg Exotics Gummies | Hala Burst
description:
200mg Hybrid Gummies.
10ct x 20mg per piece

Elevate your senses with Hala Burst, a perfectly balanced hybrid gummy. Featuring a subtly sweet, tropical tasting gummy combines the essence of Hala with juicy pineapple notes. Designed to offer a harmonious blend of relaxation and uplifting effects, Hala Burst is ideal for finding your sweet spot between calm and clarity, making it the perfect choice for any time of day.
